# Fixture for windows.system_temp. Each line: DELETE|KEEP [age=<age>] <root-relative path>.
# Default age is 365d. The test fails if a KEEP path matches or a DELETE path does not.
DELETE old.tmp
DELETE ~DF1234.tmp
DELETE setup-logs/install.log
DELETE a/b/c/d/e.bin
DELETE age=25h just-old-enough.tmp
KEEP age=1h fresh.tmp
KEEP age=23h a/b/still-fresh.bin
KEEP Login Data
KEEP chrome_xyz/Default/Login Data
KEEP copy/Bookmarks
KEEP export/logins.json
KEEP Vault.kdbx
KEEP backups/old.kdb
KEEP x/Microsoft/Protect/key
KEEP OLDFIL~1.TMP
